name: Mephenesin
summary: Mephenesin (INN), also called myanesin, is a centrally acting muscle relaxant. It can be used as an antidote for strychnine poisoning. Mephenesin however presents with the major drawbacks of having a short duration of action and a much greater effect on the spinal cord than the brain, resulting in pronounced respiratory depression at clinical doses and therefore a very low therapeutic index.

pharmacology.text: Mephenesin may be an NMDA receptor antagonist.

uses.text: It can be used as an antidote for strychnine poisoning. Mephenesin is no longer available in North America but is used in Italy and a few other countries.

summaryZh: 麥酚生（英語：Mephenesin）是一種中樞作用的肌肉鬆弛劑，可作為番木鱉鹼中毒的解毒劑。
summaryZhHans: 麦酚生（英语：Mephenesin）是一种中枢作用的肌肉松弛剂，可作为番木鳖碱中毒的解毒剂。

sideEffects.en: It can cause drowsiness, weakness, dizziness, poor coordination and nausea. Its strong effect on the spinal cord can cause marked muscle weakness.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起嗜睡、無力、頭暈、協調變差與噁心。它對脊髓的強烈作用可能造成明顯的肌肉無力。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起嗜睡、无力、头晕、协调制差与恶心。它对脊髓的强烈作用可能造成明显的肌肉无力。

fact.en: Frank Berger found mephenesin's muscle-relaxing effect in the 1940s, and his search for a longer-lasting version led him to create meprobamate, sold as Miltown.
fact.zh: 法蘭克．伯格在1940年代發現麥酚生的肌肉鬆弛作用，他為了找出作用更持久的版本，後來創造了以「眠爾通」販售的甲丙氨酯。
fact.zhHans: 法兰克．伯格在1940年代发现麦酚生的肌肉松弛作用，他为了找出作用更持久的版本，后来创造了以「眠尔通」贩售的甲丙氨酯。
